verdicts.reason: A keeps the original phone-left/text-right structure with the phone fully visible, but the two badges are blown up into full-width pills the same size as the CTA, so 'Find It Near You' reads as just a third bar in a stack. The tagline is also tiny and runs close to the right edge. B gives the headline strong hierarchy and puts the CTA first, but the phone is shrunk and cut off at the bottom edge. Its CTA and badges form a cramped, centred stack that doesn't line up with the left-aligned headline, and the small tagline floats loosely beside the phone.
